# Pre-delivery checklist

Use this checklist before handing over an artifact. Mark each item Pass, Needs work, or Not applicable. "Not verified" is not the same as Pass.

## Purpose and audience
- [ ] The page identifies what it is about quickly.
- [ ] The intended reader and their starting knowledge are reflected in the language.
- [ ] The reader can see why the content matters.
- [ ] The desired outcome or next action is clear.
- [ ] There is one primary message.

## Content and truth
- [ ] Claims are supported by the supplied material or cited sources.
- [ ] No invented features, interface labels, metrics, quotes, or outcomes appear.
- [ ] Assumptions and unknowns are flagged where they affect decisions.
- [ ] Critical prerequisites, limits, warnings, and exceptions are preserved.
- [ ] Acronyms and necessary jargon are explained.
- [ ] Repetition and filler have been removed.

## Structure and cognitive load
- [ ] The content follows a logical reader path.
- [ ] Headings are descriptive and hierarchical.
- [ ] Related information is grouped.
- [ ] The primary path is easy to distinguish from optional reference detail.
- [ ] Each section earns its place.
- [ ] Instructions include expected results where useful.

## Visual design
- [ ] The first screen communicates topic and value.
- [ ] Typography, spacing, and contrast support reading.
- [ ] Every diagram, card, callout, and interaction has a clear purpose.
- [ ] No visual treatment competes with the primary task.
- [ ] The page remains understandable without styling.

## Accessibility
- [ ] Semantic landmarks and heading levels are appropriate.
- [ ] Keyboard navigation and visible focus have been checked.
- [ ] Links and controls have meaningful names.
- [ ] Images have appropriate alt text.
- [ ] Color is not the only way meaning is conveyed.
- [ ] Text contrast has been checked.
- [ ] Zoom and reflow have been checked.
- [ ] Motion is absent or respects reduced-motion preferences.

## Responsive and technical
- [ ] The page works at narrow viewport widths.
- [ ] Content does not rely on fixed heights or widths.
- [ ] Tables and code blocks remain usable.
- [ ] Essential content works without JavaScript.
- [ ] The stylesheet and asset paths resolve.
- [ ] The HTML has been checked for basic structural errors.

## Memory and handoff
- [ ] The primary message is reinforced without redundant repetition.
- [ ] A useful next step, success check, or memory anchor is present.
- [ ] The artifact's audience and purpose are stated in the handoff.
- [ ] Testing limitations and unresolved facts are disclosed.
